5␟glass beads: Small colored glass ornaments traded into Scandinavia from the south, so prized that they functioned almost like money — handed back and forth in exchange for goods like amber heading the other way.
6␟combs from reindeer and elk antler: Fine-toothed combs cut from reindeer and elk antler, made by full-time specialist craftspeople in early Scandinavian trading towns in quantities far beyond any one household's needs — early mass production for trade.
8␟Portland incident: The first mention in any English source of Norsemen on English soil: Scandinavian sailors came ashore at Portland, a royal official rode out assuming they were ordinary traders, and they killed him — a deadly misunderstanding that opened the Viking age in England.
